text: A very special island is inhabited only by angels and devils. Angels always tell the truth, and devils always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Benjamin, and Joseph. Benjamin was heard saying, "Benjamin is an angel if and only if Joseph is a devil". Joseph commented, "Joseph is an angel if and only if Benjamin is an angel". So who is an angel and who is a devil? (Format your answer like: "Benjamin is a angel/devil, and Joseph is a angel/devil")
